# Lïef Builders

## URL
https://liefbuilders.com

## What We Are
Lïef Builders is an owner's representation and project advocacy firm based in Scottsdale, Arizona. An owner's representative is a professional who advocates exclusively for the property owner during a construction project, protecting their financial and legal interests from start to finish. With over 100 years of combined expertise, Lïef Builders puts experienced professionals on the owner's side so contractors and insurers cannot take advantage of what property owners do not know.

## Services

### Owner's Representation and Project Advocacy
Construction oversight and advocacy for property owners. Experience includes disaster recovery rebuilds (Greensburg, Kansas tornado and Santa Barbara fire damage) and luxury residential projects. Over 20 years as the owner's advocate. Every engagement is customized to the scope the project demands.

### Cost Control and Schedule Optimization
Faster builds, tighter budgets, and zero surprises. Full-scope project management including change order negotiation, site walks and inspections, vendor discount verification, value engineering, and red flag identification. Over $40M saved for clients. 100%+ minimum ROI on every engagement.

## SABS Technology
SABS (Saebi Alternative Building System) is a patented building technology available through Lïef Builders. It uses EPS foam panels with a high-strength cementitious composite coating called SABSCRETE to create a monolithic structural system. Key specifications: 0% flame spread, 250 MPH wind resistance, R-75 to R-100 insulation, and 100% mold and termite immunity. SABS delivers 15-20% cost savings and 15-20% faster build times compared to traditional construction. Lïef is the leading SABS builder in Arizona and offers SABS alongside traditional stick framing, giving clients the right building method for their project.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is an owner's representative in construction?
A: An owner's representative is a professional who advocates exclusively for the property owner during a construction project. They oversee contractors, review budgets and change orders, and ensure the project stays on schedule and on budget.

Q: Why do I need an owner's rep?
A: Most property owners lack the technical expertise to evaluate contractor bids, negotiate change orders, or identify red flags during construction. An owner's rep brings decades of industry experience to protect you from cost overruns, schedule delays, and contractor disputes.

Q: What areas does Lïef Builders serve?
A: Phoenix and Greater Arizona, Las Vegas and Nevada, and Los Angeles and Southern California.

Q: How does Lïef Builders save clients money?
A: By negotiating contracts, verifying vendor pricing, identifying red flags before they become expensive, and conducting regular site inspections. Over $40M saved for clients with a minimum 100% ROI on every engagement.

Q: What is SABS construction technology?
A: SABS (Saebi Alternative Building System) is a patented building technology using EPS foam panels with SABSCRETE cementitious coating. It delivers 0% flame spread, 250 MPH wind resistance, R-75 to R-100 insulation, and 100% mold/termite immunity. Lïef offers SABS alongside traditional stick framing.
